text: The Black Knife Assassins fight using blades carrying the influence of the Rune of Death.
In battle, Ansbach uses the Furious Blade of Ansbach, an incantation summoning a bloodflame blade that he lunges with to strike enemies, becoming stronger when charged.
Ansbach also wields the Obsidian Lamina, a slender scythe relying on skill rather than tricks.

Freyja wields a Greatsword decorated with a mane, reflecting her connection to Radahn and her strength as a warrior, and carries the Golden Lion Shield, a symbol of Radahn's personal guard awarded to only his most valorous knights.
Igon created his own weapon, Igon's Harpoon, a great arrow adorned with sharp gravel stone pieces designed to be deadly against dragons.
Igon's Greatbow is crafted from dragon bones bound with rope and scarred by claws, enhancing the power of his harpoons.
Queelign's Greatsword was remade by Queelign in the shape of the lance once wielded by his liege, symbolizing his desire to become a second Impaler.
